Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
cbo...@apdi.net (Sorrow) writes:
>Can another meth block this action (Sacrificial Lamb) if it is being used at
>minor? It is not a directed action (I know this because - a: it doesn't have
>the D and b: you cannot do directed actions against yourself), but there are
>other non-directed actions (I think) that can be blocked.
>Just curious.

Yes. Undirected actions (inferior Sacrificial Lamb, hunting, calling a
vote, etc.) can be blocked by your Prey or Predator. You Prey has first
opportunity to attempt to block. Once she gives up or declines to block,
then your Predator can attempt to block.

Most undirected actions have inherent stealth (hunting, calling a vote).

Sacrificial Lamb doesn't, so has a base zero stealth (and should be
easily blocked by either your Prey or Predator).
